summary: Tilly's, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on June 10, 2026, solely to disclose an amendment to its existing credit agreement with Wells Fargo Bank, N.A. The Second Amendment extends the maturity date from June 25, 2027 to September 10, 2028. No special-situation event occurred: no M&A, activist, restructuring, or corporate action. This is a routine financing arrangement with no change in ownership, control, or strategy. The filing is a material definitive agreement but does not contain any transaction qualifying as a special situation.
